common.generation_instruction: Using the specified already sealed initial model, produce a bounded next beat of action and any dialogue the model supports. Outside the scene, explain attention/appraisal, competing motives, relationship effects, relevant resource or knowledge limits, one plausible alternative and a fact that would change the choice. Do not manufacture facts hidden from the subject, guarantee unknown success, settle unresolved canon relationships, or quote a canonical scene as a substitute for reasoning. Silence is permitted when explained; no minimum utterance count. Do not inspect evaluator-only hidden facts or rubric notes while generating. Treat another character’s private information as inaccessible to everyone else unless actually communicated. Stop before inventing an unanswered inquiry’s reply or an unknown physical result; conditional plans are permitted.
common.canonical_mode_common: Hypothetical new situation compatible with the admitted main world, not an assertion of a missing canonical event. Use actual source-supported capabilities and actual current readiness/consent/limits, modified by explicit case conditions. Comic display can amplify expression but does not erase named injuries, ownership, deadlines or agency.
common.transfer_mode_common: Same person-level goals, relationships, appraisals and memory of the admitted main history, explicitly informed that the local world has no usable magic, resurrection, supernatural luck, class buffs or comic injury immunity. Their unfamiliarity is retained. Do not grant equivalent real-world professional expertise by analogy. Case-specific ordinary tools replace means transparently; motives and stakes are not deleted to make behavior polite or bland.
common.state_common: Each case starts independently. No consequences or learning carry from another case or mode unless stated. These are not chronological canon continuations or validation witnesses. New unnamed counterparts are adults. The established cast retains the admitted age/state without invented aging; no sexual action is requested.
common.response_visibility: The executable prompt contains subject/shared available information plus explicitly owner-labelled private information for party scenes. A generator may portray that owner’s appraisal but must not give it to another character without disclosure. Evaluator-hidden facts, diagnostics, alternatives and rubric never enter generation prompts.
common.release_rule: Keep actual prompts and evaluator bank sealed from root, producer and independent model authors until all relevant initial model arguments are sealed. Do not evaluate responses before published specialist gate closure, fresh authority reload, initial model receipt and explicit execution release. No model authorship is authorized by this preparatory bank.

Jealous framing may be a bias, but cannot be certified as objective proof of sabotage.
individual_cases.nearest_contrast_not_an_extra_execution: If Darkness had known and intentionally interfered, attribution would change; the present information does not establish that.

The role is optional; another adult volunteer is available.

Megumin asks what she herself wants, without promising that any answer will produce praise.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: The organizer will accept a refusal without contempt; that future reaction is not yet known to Darkness.
canonical_comic_conditions: Her actual endurance does not replace consent to scheduling or public exposure. No performed harmful act has already occurred.

relationship_state.baseline: Hypothetical ordinary day after the admitted main sequence; retain particular established attachments, unresolved labels and prior failures. No new romance, marriage, sex, exclusivity or party expulsion is established.

individual_cases.stakes: He likes games and could gain a useful voucher. The system cannot be attacked or stolen from without cancelling everyone’s session.

There are four participants, decisions are simultaneous and no one can see others’ choice before locking their own.
One token buys a meal; there is no leaderboard, hidden jackpot or skill-point effect.
Aqua proposes talking first but cannot bind the two strangers.

canonical_comic_conditions: A fixed-rule teaching artifact with no inspectable exploit beyond the stated rules. Gamer knowledge can supply reasoning, not a secret engine command.
transfer_conditions: An unfamiliar but fully explained electronic kiosk; no hacking, luck magic or advanced computer expertise. Same payoffs and anonymous locking.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Does the model reason from the supplied novel incentive structure rather than copy a nearest gambling scene?
Does uncertainty about others remain explicit, and does any social proposal have a feasible mechanism?

Neither selfish nor cooperative choice is the prescribed character answer; unsupported certainty about strangers is the diagnostic risk.

individual_cases.subject: Aqua
individual_cases.title: Anonymous repairs and delayed credit

relationship_state.baseline: Hypothetical ordinary day after the admitted main sequence; retain particular established attachments, unresolved labels and prior failures. No new romance, marriage, sex, exclusivity or party expulsion is established.
relationship_state.current_state: Aqua can perform a small useful repair now and receives a private receipt. A public ceremonial title is offered for attending tomorrow, whether or not she repairs.

individual_cases.setting: Aqua and Megumin enter a screened repair booth at an unfamiliar community workshop. The public repair log hides maker names until a monthly reveal; the chair owner sends a written request through an attendant.
individual_cases.stakes: Aqua can perform a small useful repair now and receives a private receipt. A public ceremonial title is offered for attending tomorrow, whether or not she repairs.
subject_available_information: The repair will materially help a known elderly adult use a chair safely today. The owner is outside the screen and cannot see the maker.

The private receipt accurately records Aqua’s contribution. Megumin knows who did the repair; the official public log will hide the name for a month. Aqua could choose to show her own receipt or introduce herself, but no audience recognition is promised.
The public ceremonial title tomorrow confers no technical power, money or control over the log.
The chair owner asks for help in writing but says refusal is permitted; another repairer may come next week. Megumin has offered neither praise nor criticism.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: The later reveal will be accurate, but its audience size and reaction are unknown.
canonical_comic_conditions: Ordinary demonstrated craft is available; no divine command can force sincere recognition. The log is not a truth test for all motives.
transfer_conditions: A realistic voluntary workshop with the same anonymity and actual practical effect, no magic or inferred saintly duty.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Can immediate usefulness, delayed acknowledgment, a symbolic role and choice remain separate in a novel institution?
Does the speech account allow practical service with or without directive language rather than resurrecting the failed broad tendency?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Repair, postpone, ask for visible credit, attend the ceremony, decline or propose another arrangement are possible.
The evaluator does not reward public modesty as the only plausible outcome.
individual_cases.nearest_contrast_not_an_extra_execution: Immediate named recognition would change reward timing, not create the underlying craft ability or prove a unique motive.

individual_cases.title: The non-destructive scale room

relationship_state.baseline: Hypothetical ordinary day after the admitted main sequence; retain particular established attachments, unresolved labels and prior failures. No new romance, marriage, sex, exclusivity or party expulsion is established.
relationship_state.current_state: She may choose one grand presentation or several adjustable smaller presentations. There is no skill reward and the room does not spend her spell points.

individual_cases.setting: Megumin and Darkness enter a demonstration room that can show the visible shape and sound of a designed effect without causing destruction.
individual_cases.stakes: She may choose one grand presentation or several adjustable smaller presentations. There is no skill reward and the room does not spend her spell points.
subject_available_information: A live demonstration proves that both options are harmless projections inside the room.
The controls permit adjustment after each trial, but she has never used them.
A spectator asks about beauty and precision rather than which option is more useful in war.
Nothing requires her to call the smaller effects Explosion or to change her real build outside the room.

canonical_comic_conditions: The device does not duplicate actual spell power or prove readiness for real combat. Her magical specialization outside the room remains unchanged.
transfer_conditions: A projection-and-sound studio with the same verified non-destructive function and readable controls; no prior digital-art expertise. Her aesthetic identity remains, with its transfer limits acknowledged.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Does the model reason about representation versus the valued real practice, without inventing a forced rebuild or denigration?
Can enthusiasm, refusal, experimentation or performance be causally explained from the novel affordance and known uncertainty?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Try either scale, ask questions, refuse imitation, compare outputs or invite Darkness’s opinion are open.
No assumption that harmless substitution must satisfy or offend her is scored as ground truth.
individual_cases.nearest_contrast_not_an_extra_execution: A device claiming to replace her real chosen art would introduce a different identity threat; this device makes no such claim.

relationship_state.current_state: A training rescue has no victim danger today; tomorrow’s real operation will need an operator. Her public name can be shown or kept private.

individual_cases.setting: Darkness and Kazuma are offered a remote training shell that can move a heavy barrier while its operator stays in a safe room.
individual_cases.stakes: A training rescue has no victim danger today; tomorrow’s real operation will need an operator. Her public name can be shown or kept private.
subject_available_information: A supervised demonstration verifies that damage to the shell does not transmit pain or injury.
Operating it requires learning a simple control sequence with a trainer; she does not already know it.
The rescue function is real, but personal bodily endurance is irrelevant while the operator stays outside.
Kazuma asks whether she wants to train, without mocking her motives or volunteering her name.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: The trainer will not interpret a request for anonymity as cowardice, but has not said that.
canonical_comic_conditions: A remote golem shell with precisely demonstrated isolation; not evidence she can control any golem or is otherwise immune to pain.
transfer_conditions: An ordinary remote mechanical training rig with no magical aptitude transfer. Safe console and trainer remain; no robotics expertise assumed.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Does the model distinguish useful protection, personal exposure, public identity and the value of bodily involvement in a genuinely new setting?
Can willingness to train, refusal or a request for conditions be explained without inferring that absence of pain eliminates all protective motives?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Train, ask for a demonstration, volunteer privately, decline, prefer another role or request more time are possible.
Neither seeking danger nor accepting the safe shell is predetermined as the faithful answer.

party_cases.title: The late common meal
party_cases.relationship_state: All four remain familiar companions with unresolved particular romantic labels, real irritation, reciprocal history and separate agency. No compulsory leader or universal party indispensability.
party_cases.setting: The four return to a shared house to find the common stove unavailable for thirty minutes.
party_available_information: There is enough cold food for all, a nearby cook closes in twenty minutes, and the available shared cash buys two prepared meals.
Nobody caused the fault; the caretaker has already explained the delay.
Each can choose separately. Darkness asks anyone leaving to say whether they will return for the shared meal; this is her request, not a compulsory response rule.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: The stove returns in twenty-five minutes rather than thirty; no one knows that exact time.
canonical_comic_conditions: Ordinary magic may be considered only within source-supported safe heating uses and permission; no invented free restaurant.
transfer_conditions: No magic, same cold food, cash and time; no new cooking expertise.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Do distinct preferences and relationship expectations produce compatible interaction rather than four identical reactions?
Does ordinary division of labor remain possible without mandatory catastrophe or catchphrases?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Wait, split purchases, cook something safe, eat separately, bargain or quarrel can all be coherent if timing and money stay consistent.

party_cases.title: The common windfall
party_cases.relationship_state: All four remain familiar companions with unresolved particular romantic labels, real irritation, reciprocal history and separate agency. No compulsory leader or universal party indispensability.
party_cases.setting: A joint neighborhood job pays the party twenty tokens and offers a choice of reimbursement schedules.
party_available_information: Six of the twenty tokens cover agreed material costs. Eight cover a useful household repair. Six remain freely negotiable.

Each has voiced one optional six-token personal use: Kazuma a board-game event entry; Aqua painting pigments; Megumin a decorative cloak clasp; Darkness a tea-service gift for her father. None has been approved by the others.
These are explicit present hypothetical wants, not newly asserted permanent preferences or a required spending order. The client will not pay twice or choose the division.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: There is no hidden individual bonus and no right answer selected by the client.
canonical_comic_conditions: No unshown royalties or noble subsidy may erase the stated local budget; ordinary borrowing needs explicit agreement.
transfer_conditions: Same small budget in ordinary money; no magic or supernatural income shortcut.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Are joint ownership, contribution and private desires represented separately?
Can alliances change by issue instead of making one permanent sensible adult and three fools?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Equal division, saving, unequal agreed shares, a contest with consent, argument or postponement can be assessed; no allocation is preselected.

party_cases.title: An outsider’s collaboration offer
party_cases.relationship_state: All four remain familiar companions with unresolved particular romantic labels, real irritation, reciprocal history and separate agency. No compulsory leader or universal party indispensability.
party_cases.setting: A competent adult organizer invites the party to help at a public exhibition.
party_available_information: The organizer offers four optional twenty-minute tasks at two tokens each: Kazuma make a registration route/list; Aqua repair two loose poster frames; Megumin select display names and write a spoken introduction; Darkness help staff position a waiting lane.

The organizer refers to an actual observed planning, craft, presentation or protective contribution for each person, rather than declaring any one globally capable. They admit the schedule is incomplete and invite corrections.
Local staff retain safety approval. Pay is equal for equal hours; no one is called useless, compelled to accept, or threatened with replacement.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: The organizer is sincere, but a sincere offer does not guarantee perfect execution.
canonical_comic_conditions: Tasks use ordinary craft, protective positioning, planning and a safe marked demonstration; no automatic divine or noble authority.
transfer_conditions: Tasks are ordinary planning, craft, visitor safety and non-destructive presentation. No magical professional credentials are added.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Does the group preserve individual appraisal of admiration, uncertainty and work rather than treating all praise as a trap or cure?
Do actual task acceptances precede later role-function judgments?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Accept separately, negotiate, ask details, demonstrate, refuse or make a counteroffer are available.

party_cases.title: The group credit card
party_cases.relationship_state: All four remain familiar companions with unresolved particular romantic labels, real irritation, reciprocal history and separate agency. No compulsory leader or universal party indispensability.
party_cases.setting: A meeting displays a card assigning the party’s last minor job entirely to Kazuma.
party_available_information: The minor completed job had four observed parts: Kazuma arranged the cart and written delivery list; Aqua repaired its loose wooden frame; Megumin prepared clear labels and gave destination information; Darkness carried the bulky boxes safely.
Kazuma did not write the credit card; the clerk admits using an abbreviated note.
A corrected card can name all contributions without reducing the agreed total pay.
A small adult audience is waiting; nobody has yet blamed a member for demanding correction.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: The clerk made an innocent mistake; the audience’s private judgments are unknown.
canonical_comic_conditions: A comic civic meeting with real credit effects, no mind-reading or proof of global worth from one card.
transfer_conditions: A workplace volunteer meeting with the same facts and correction option, no magic or noble override.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Does the conversation distribute correction, self-presentation and regard for others without assuming public agreement?
Can the narrator be questioned without discarding all observed contributions?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Quiet correction, public explanation, joking, disagreement, silence or competing credit claims are possible, with consequences retained.

party_cases.title: The injury beside the unfinished job
party_cases.relationship_state: All four remain familiar companions with unresolved particular romantic labels, real irritation, reciprocal history and separate agency. No compulsory leader or universal party indispensability.
party_cases.setting: While the party finishes a paid cleanup, an adult worker outside their group is injured by a falling board.
party_available_information: The injury is real and the worker is conscious but cannot walk alone.
A staffed care post is five minutes away and can be summoned by a visible signal.
The remaining paid job takes ten minutes, and the client explicitly permits a delay for assistance.
No party member caused the falling board, and no hidden enemy is established.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: The care post has capacity, but the exact diagnosis is unknown.
canonical_comic_conditions: Actual healing capability and willingness are model-governed; no cure or exhaustion is assumed before action. Practical transport/signal help remains feasible.
transfer_conditions: No magical healing; basic instruction card, signal and staffed post remain. No emergency medical certification is invented.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Can readiness, authority, fitted help and moral choice be separated?
Does a useful act avoid making everyone’s interpretation benevolent or every utterance practical by definition?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Divide duties, summon help, provide bounded care, accompany the worker, argue or fail to help can be assessed; moral and model-consistency judgments are recorded separately.

party_cases.title: A known route and an unknown crack
party_cases.relationship_state: All four remain familiar companions with unresolved particular romantic labels, real irritation, reciprocal history and separate agency. No compulsory leader or universal party indispensability.
party_cases.setting: On a planned route, the party hears harmless rattling decorations and then sees a real crack opening in a footbridge beneath an adult traveler.
party_available_information: The decorations cannot reach them. The bridge crack is visible and the traveler asks for help.
A stable bank, rope and anchor point are reachable without entering the cracked span.
The party’s own footing is currently safe, but direct entry risks more weight.
An alternate path can reach the far bank in ten minutes; no exact collapse time is known.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: The bridge holds for several minutes if nobody adds weight; models cannot know the hidden timing.
canonical_comic_conditions: Known magical/physical capacities may affect means but do not establish guaranteed immunity or safe destructive fire near the traveler.
transfer_conditions: No supernatural capacity, same rope, stable bank and alternate path; normal injury risk.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Do fear, personal risk and a valued companion’s possible intervention remain distinct from the stranger’s actual danger?
Can disagreement over means coexist with a coherent shared information state?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Rope plan, warning, alternate route, direct rescue, outside help or refusal are possible; invented certainty about collapse is not.

party_cases.title: The two-part exhibition
party_cases.relationship_state: All four remain familiar companions with unresolved particular romantic labels, real irritation, reciprocal history and separate agency. No compulsory leader or universal party indispensability.
party_cases.setting: The party must prepare a room and submit a technical safety diagram for a small public exhibition.
party_available_information: The room is eight by six paces, with one two-pace-wide exit and four folding tables. There is no crowd present yet. Decoration, a timetable and an open waiting lane must be arranged.
The power diagram contains boxes α→β→γ but no symbol legend; a visible label says not to connect them before consulting the legend. A qualified local technician can bring it after lunch.
The show can be delayed without injury or financial ruin.
No one is already designated leader or licensed inspector.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: One plausible-looking connection is unsafe; the missing legend would reveal it.
canonical_comic_conditions: Specialist magic, craft or rank does not confer knowledge of unknown local power symbols.
transfer_conditions: Ordinary venue setup, no magic or new engineering credentials. The same guide/technician boundary holds.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Does complementarity include asking outsiders instead of universal four-member necessity?
Are confidence, competence, learning and delegated responsibility separately observable?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Divide known tasks, wait, ask, test reversibly with permission, bluff or withdraw can be assessed without a preselected organizer.

party_cases.title: The next household schedule
party_cases.relationship_state: All four remain familiar companions with unresolved particular romantic labels, real irritation, reciprocal history and separate agency. No compulsory leader or universal party indispensability.
party_cases.setting: The party holds a private meeting after two members separately volunteered another person’s time without asking.
party_available_information: Kazuma volunteered Aqua for decoration from 14:00 to 16:00; Aqua volunteered Darkness for a separate errand in that same interval.
Both admit making the assumption and neither claims prior consent.
A group discussion at 19:00 is now proposed. Megumin has not answered whether she is free; nobody else has been told a reason.
All jobs are optional and reschedulable; everyone can state a boundary without immediate exclusion.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: The outside organizers have backup plans unknown to the group.
canonical_comic_conditions: Familiar comic argument does not erase actual scheduling or privacy boundaries; no forced romance disclosure or expulsion.
transfer_conditions: A realistic shared-home calendar conversation, with ordinary consequences and no magical reset.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Can nested grievances remain actor-specific rather than collapsed into one victim or universal hypocrisy?
Does agreement or conflict reflect actual information and agency, with private plans not automatically public?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Apology, rules, bargaining, mutual accusations, selective consent, postponement or unresolved conflict can be coherent.

Megumin: She has privately promised Yunyun to meet for a board game at 19:00. She has not told the other three. This hypothetical promise is known only to her until she chooses disclosure.

party_cases.title: A reversible role station
party_cases.relationship_state: All four remain familiar companions with unresolved particular romantic labels, real irritation, reciprocal history and separate agency. No compulsory leader or universal party indispensability.
party_cases.setting: An unfamiliar training station lets the four operate one shared public-service display through four interchangeable consoles.
party_available_information: Each of four consoles has identical left, right and confirm controls. A trainer has demonstrated routing a colored visitor token to the matching waiting lane; a wrong input delays a token by one minute and cannot physically trap or injure a visitor.
The display needs two operators at a time and permits rotation, breaks and refusal. Neither console carries their usual title or unique power.
A screen gives accurate anonymous group service counts, not individual scores.
The task is genuinely useful to visitors, but there is no crisis or promise of personal recognition. Nobody is already assigned command.
evaluator_only_hidden_facts: Feedback is accurate and contains no concealed ranking; participants do not know whether visitors will later request names.
canonical_comic_conditions: A fixed-function enchanted training device with demonstrated controls. It grants no permanent new powers or guaranteed role obedience.
transfer_conditions: An ordinary interactive public-information installation, no magic, same training and anonymity.
case_specific_causal_voice_questions: Does the group reason from unfamiliar equal affordances instead of copying a raid, making Kazuma necessary or forcing every identity to dominate?
Can play, status, craft, shared effort and withdrawal produce a coherent negotiated configuration without a single correct allocation?
acceptable_response_alternatives_not_pre: Rotate, specialize voluntarily, seek recognition, bargain, demonstrate, refuse or redistribute can be assessed if the task’s two-person requirement and individual agency remain.

rubric.governing_sections: Reconstruction protocol §§9–10; modes §6; no promotion or source validation by this bank.

dimensions.question: Which expressed/prior-model motive explains attention and chosen action? Does the explanation cite the sealed model and relevant accepted evidence rather than a trait label alone?
What appraisal distortion, shortcut or regulator operated, or is its absence justified? Do not require a failure in every case.
Which actual relationship/audience modifier mattered? Did the subject act only on available information, preserving other agents’ knowledge and agency?
Is comic amplification source-bounded? Does transfer change physics and available means while preserving motives and accounting for known ordinary harm?
Is a seriousness override supported, ignored, or invented? A harmful choice can be model-consistent; do not score moral niceness as fidelity.
Does speech fit speaker/addressee/purpose and ordinary connective needs without catchphrase spam? Separate action from language function; silence can make voice unobservable.
Can a nearby changed fact produce a different response for a stated reason? The listed contrast is a diagnostic discussion, not another independent execution.
Does the model retain missing knowledge, thin source scope and plausible rival paths instead of fabricating certainty or a unique interior motive?

rubric.decision_rule: No aggregate personality accuracy, weighted score or majority vote. Record case-level consistency, qualified tension, material contradiction or unscorable status with reasons. A material contradiction requires a specific known fact, hard capability limit, frozen source constraint or the initial model’s own commitment; disagreement about an OPEN function remains qualified. One vivid failure does not validate a new universal rule. The model’s actual disconfirming condition remains assessable even when other actions were physically feasible. Do not transform an adverse response into confirmation by choosing a different plausible motive after observation.
adverse_history_guards: Keep Gen03 K04 F and later agency distinctions; tears are not a universal brake unless a new model actually defends that condition.
Keep Gen05 J01 A_SERVICE F with MODERATE pragmatic confidence and real rivals; helpful action is not automatically a practical directive.
Do not require first role onset, professional work, a particular addressee/name/pronoun, fresh verbal adoption or morphological imperative as a universal floor.
Do not erase a harmful act through later laughter, survival, repair or affection.
Do not import D02 whole behavioral antecedents into every dignity-language observation.
No quota/completed-harem floor repairs K03; admiration, completion and optional continuation remain distinct.
No frequency or reliability statistic from overlapping cases, common authorship, paired modes or shared evidence.
rubric.hidden_fact_rule: Hidden world facts are evaluator-only bookkeeping, not response requirements. Do not penalize uncertainty or a mistaken inference merely because the omniscient evaluator knows the truth. Penalize claiming unprovided certainty only when the model cannot support its access. Hidden facts describe hypothetical settings, not new canon. A character’s mistaken but warranted belief is not failed consistency solely because an assessor knows better. If inquiry is chosen, score the inquiry/conditional plan and leave the unprovided reply or outcome unresolved; do not invent a favorable answer to make a path work.
rubric.voice_rule: Prefer Japanese written dialogue when the model supports it, with an explanatory gloss if needed. If dialogue is absent or output is only a paraphrase, mark linguistic surface NOT_OBSERVABLE rather than invent an effect. No audio/native-speaker claim and no new L assignment.
rubric.acceptable_alternatives_rule: Listed alternatives identify feasible response paths; they are not automatic passes, an exhaustive action menu or predicted character answers. Before response generation, reviewers must bind the sealed initial model’s applicable clauses, scope, hard predictions, uncertainty and disconfirming conditions to each fixed case. A merely possible action fails that model’s prediction when its actual guard is met and its specified effect is contradicted. Do not add conditions or switch explanation after seeing the output. A response outside listed alternatives can pass only when fixed facts and the actual model commitments support it. Moral approval remains separate from fidelity; a source-uncharacteristic nice response can fail and a harmful coherent response can still be adverse to a claimed brake.

pre_execution_model_contract_required.rule: Derive this entry from the already sealed model before generating or reading its case response. Do not alter case facts, old forecasts or initial model bytes. If the model is too underspecified to yield an assessable commitment, record UNTESTABLE_MODEL_SCOPE rather than allowing every action to count as success. Genuine qualified outcomes and adverse responses remain. Any later model refinement is versioned outside the baseline.
